quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does a yellow light that flashes on and off mean?

options.text: Stop and look for other vehicles. Go only if the road is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to cross the intersection quickly.
Slow down and go carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and go carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign do?

options.text: Can be ignored when it is rainy, snowy, or icy.
Has a triangle shape.
Is blue with black letters.
Shows the safe speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows the safe speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Speed signs near curves and turns show a recommended speed. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the recommended speed.

questions.question: You want to turn left at a green light, but many cars are coming toward you. What should you do?

options.text: Use the next intersection instead.
Wait at the crosswalk for the road to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for the road to clear.
Turn now because you have a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for the road to clear.
questions.explanation: You can enter the intersection when the light is green, but you must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn left.

questions.question: When should you turn on your headlights?

options.text: When you cannot see at least 1,000 feet ahead.
When you cannot see at least 500 feet ahead.
When you cannot see at least 300 feet ahead.
When you cannot see at least 200 feet ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you cannot see at least 1,000 feet ahead.
questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights whenever you cannot see at least 1,000 feet in front of your car.

questions.question: A car is heading toward you in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn, steer right, and speed up.
Honk your horn, steer left, and brake.
Honk your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay centered, honk your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First honk your horn to get the other driver's attention. Then steer right to escape. Steering left is dangerous because the other driver may correct at the last second, causing a crash. Brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the impact.

questions.question: When do roads become very slippery?

options.text: When it has been raining for over an hour.
The day after it rains.
For the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
Right after the rain stops.

questions.correctAnswerText: For the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. The rain brings oil from the asphalt up to the surface. Heat makes this even worse.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
Bicycles always have the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.
questions.explanation: A cyclist may need to swerve suddenly to avoid an object on the road. Always drive carefully around bicycles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a sharp curve ahead in the direction of the arrow. Multiple signs may be placed throughout the curve.

questions.question: You reach an intersection blocked by traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Drive slowly until traffic moves.
Get as close as possible to the car ahead.
Wait outside the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
Honk to make cars move forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait outside the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if traffic is blocked on the other side. Wait until the road ahead is clear so you can pass completely through.

questions.question: A driver's left arm is extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points upward, they are signaling that they will turn right. Adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.question: What does it mean when you must stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and then go when it is safe?

options.text: A solid red light.
A flashing yellow light.
A solid green light.
A flashing red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing red light.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when the way is clear.

questions.question: Is it safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads, even if you reduce your speed?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snowy or icy roads. Your tires can lose grip, and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
Keep your front wheels straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharply away from the curb when parking uphill. This stops your car from rolling into traffic if your brakes fail.

questions.question: A fully loaded truck traveling at 55 mph needs about ____ to stop completely.

options.text: 50 feet
125 feet
400 feet
750 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 400 feet
questions.explanation: Large trucks take much longer to stop than cars at the same speed. A fully loaded truck at 55 mph needs about 400 feet to stop.

questions.question: Which statement is true about motorcycles?

options.text: Other drivers can follow motorcycles closely without risk.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than with one rider.
You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
You can see a motorcycle's brake lights every time it slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use a full lane. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: Your car's gas pedal gets stuck while driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Blow your horn.
Slam on your brakes.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn off your ignition carefully so the steering wheel does not lock.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your ignition carefully so the steering wheel does not lock.
questions.explanation: Turn off the engine by moving the ignition switch just enough to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply your brakes and pull to a safe area.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?

options.text: Red.
Yellow.
Green.
Blue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to unexpected road conditions.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, which side should a pedestrian walk on?

options.text: The side with the lightest traffic.
The same side traffic is moving.
The side facing oncoming traffic.
The side with the heaviest traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: The side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road that faces the traffic coming toward you.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your car does not have an Anti-Lock Braking System, what should you do?

options.text: Hold down the brake pedal.
Pump your brakes firmly.
Tap the brakes lightly.
Release the brake pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pump your brakes firmly.
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop quickly. Your car will stop faster and you can still steer.

questions.question: When should you slow down when exiting a highway?

options.text: On the main road just before the exit lane.
Once you see a toll booth.
After you move into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane first. Then slow down once you are in the exit lane.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers:

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When they are on a road to your left and you reach an unmarked intersection at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield to other drivers when entering a street from an alley, driveway, or garage. You must also yield to pedestrians on the intersecting sidewalk.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads:

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to maintain a steady speed.
Reduce your following distance.
Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: You should use high beam headlights when driving in fog.

options.text: TRUE
FALSE

questions.correctAnswerText: FALSE
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and shine into your eyes.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
Work crew ahead.
Side road.
Playground ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should slow down.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that show direction and distance information.

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show direction and distance to specific places. They help drivers navigate unfamiliar areas.
